title: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, 1949 Washington D.C. Snapshot B&W Photo
back_text_transcription:
Tomb of Unknown Soldier
Washington D.C.
June 4, 5, 1949
description: A black and white snapshot captured in June 1949 depicting the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier located at Arlington National Cemetery near Washington, D.C. Two commemorative floral wreaths are displayed prominently at the base of the marble monument, while two female visitors stand on the plaza to the left. The image reflects post-World War II American patriotic remembrance and travel to national landmarks in the late 1940s.
